channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Middle East and Central Asia’s economy to shrink in 2026 amid war, IMF says
item.description: Iraq, Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar face double-digit declines in GDP amid the fallout from the US-Israel war on Iran.

item.title: Ronaldo waves Saudi-flag scarf after match interrupted by missile alert
item.description: Portuguese superstar Cristiano Ronaldo waved a scarf with the Saudi flag after Al Nassr’s victory.

item.title: Trump insists energy ceasefire holds as Ukraine reports new Russian strikes
item.description: US President urges Zelenskyy, Putin to end 'ridiculous war' and insists they agreed to stop attacks on energy sites.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine trade strikes amid doubt over ‘energy ceasefire’
item.description: Ukraine's president says Russian attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure are continuing despite 'energy ceasefire'.

item.title: Iran war live: Qatar urges stronger efforts to secure Gulf maritime routes
item.description: US President Trump condemns Yemen's Houthis over escalating attacks, as Saudi Arabia halts flights at Riyadh airport.

item.title: Houthi missile attack targets Saudi capital Riyadh for third day in a row
item.description: Saudi Arabia claims it downed a ballistic missile fired at Riyadh, as the Houthis say they targeted King Khalid airport.

item.title: Two deaths reported as Hurricane Simon, storm Rachel batter Mexico’s coast
item.description: Simon caps a Pacific season of record-breaking intensity, as deadly storms wreak havoc from Hawaii to Mexico.

item.title: Why do Iran’s oil ‘intermediaries’ owe the government billions?
item.description: Iran says intermediaries handling its oil sales owe it billions of dollars, but how did the debts accumulate?

item.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
item.description: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

item.title: Mourners killed by Kenya police at ex-PM's national farewell not part of violence, BBC finds
item.description: After analysing 1,500 videos and images of the Raila Odinga memorial, Africa Eye finds that those killed were far from the scuffles.
